title: Group fairness
description: Applicants in the 'Less than 25' group (age_cat) receive a favourable outcome 36% of the time versus 78% for 'Greater than 45', below the four-fifths benchmark.
recommendation: Investigate the drivers of the gap (see proxy-feature results), consider reweighing or threshold adjustment, and document a fairness rationale approved by the risk owner. Attributes needing action: race, age_cat.
controls: NIST:MEASURE-2.11; NIST:MAP-5.1; ISO42001:A.5.4; ISO42001:A.7.4; EUAIA:Art-10; INDIA:SUTRA-FAIRNESS; NIST-GAI:HARMFUL-BIAS; ISO42005:6.8.2

title: Intersectional fairness
description: The combined group 'African-American × Less than 25' is treated less favourably than any single attribute reveals.
recommendation: Report subgroup metrics alongside single-attribute metrics and set an explicit subgroup tolerance. Collect more data for subgroups below the minimum sample size.

title: Proxy-feature screening
description: Some inputs (e.g. 'age') closely track 'age_cat', so the model can discriminate indirectly even though that attribute is excluded.
recommendation: For each flagged feature, document a business justification, test model variants without it, and compare fairness and performance. Remove protected attributes from inputs unless a documented legal basis allows them.
controls: NIST:MEASURE-2.11; NIST:MAP-2.3; ISO42001:A.7.4; ISO42001:A.7.6; EUAIA:Art-10; INDIA:SUTRA-FAIRNESS

title: Calibration
description: Risk scores do not match observed outcome rates closely enough to be read as probabilities.
recommendation: Apply isotonic or Platt calibration on a held-out set and re-check per group.

title: Predictive performance
description: The model tells good and bad outcomes apart correctly about 71% of the time, which meets the bar set for this use.
recommendation: Track AUC in production monitoring with an alert at the declared minimum.

title: Risk classification
description: This is a high-risk AI use under the EU AI Act, with strict duties on testing, documentation and human oversight.
recommendation: Record the classification and its basis in the AI inventory, have the accountable executive sign it off, and plan for each upcoming obligation.
